integrity: The all-length proof, exact definitions, and independently implemented finite checker are included; the review is not independent certification. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats binary circles with exactly two marked symbols, not higher fixed weights or unrestricted circular-palindrome maxima. The original 2014 primary paper full text was inaccessible, creating residual priority uncertainty. Finite computations corroborate the all-length proof but are not its foundation.
title: Parity rigidity and exceptional fluctuations of palindromes in two-marker circular words
